subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should native chats execute assistant-authored Canvas HTML under the proposed isolated-WebView and capability-URL security model?
rationale: The patch introduces a deliberate model-content execution boundary across WebKit and Android WebView; tests can validate mechanics, but acceptance of the residual token, network, process, and isolation threat model requires repository-owner judgment.

options.title: Approve with boundary proof
options.body: Accept the native widget model after a focused security review, exact-head revalidation, and one macOS live interaction artifact.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Ship only the native surfaces whose isolation and live behavior are already reviewed, leaving the remaining platform for a follow-up.

options.title: Defer native execution
options.body: Keep `show_widget` limited to existing browser and Discord surfaces if the native HTML execution boundary is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve with boundary proof
recommendation.body: Accept the native widget model after a focused security review, exact-head revalidation, and one macOS live interaction artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the repository-wide CODEOWNER and has carried the implementation and review corrections across all affected native surfaces.
